# GET /api/v1/gitignore/templates/{name}

Returns information about a specific gitignore template

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** none · **ID:** `ep-012`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| name | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — GitignoreTemplateInfo

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Name of the gitignore template |
| `source` | string | Content of the gitignore template |

- **404** — Template name does not exist in gitignore directory
